jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher Position— N-terminomics and Protease Degradomics (m/f/d)   (11/2026) (UX-Researcher/in)
jobs.description:
Your area of responsibility The question How does proteolytic regulation control plant plasma-membrane receptor function and plant immune responses? The plant plasma membrane is a dynamic hub for nutrient uptake, pathogen detection and stress signalling, anchored by surface receptors. In animals, proteolytic cleavage of membrane proteins is a major regulatory mechanism in immunity. In plants, its role remains largely unexplored. FRONTERA, funded by the European Research Council through an ERC Starting Grant, sets out to close that gap. The project combines chemoproteomics, cell biology, protease biochemistry and genetics, and looks at both sides of the process: the proteases that cut, and the substrates they act on. It is curiosity-driven research with a long view towards crop resilience and sustainable agriculture. Your tasks:
• You will lead the degradomics side of FRONTERA, establishing terminomics in our system to identify cleaved substrates and map where they are cut.
• Establish and optimise a terminomics workflow for plant samples
• Identify protease substrates and determine cleavage sites, and follow how processing changes during immune responses
• Develop the data analysis alongside the wet-lab method, working with our in-house mass spectrometry facility
• Validate candidate cleavage events biochemically and relate them to immune signalling, in collaboration with the team
• Co-supervise a doctoral researcher
• Present and publish your scientific data

Your profile Essential
• A doctoral degree in biochemistry, analytical chemistry, molecular biology, plant science or a closely related field. If your thesis is submitted but not yet defended by the start date, please apply and tell us your timeline.
• Substantial hands-on experience in MS-based proteomics, working independently from sample preparation through to data analysis
• Interest in mentoring a doctoral researcher
• Excellent English language skills, written and spoken. German is not required.

Desirable
• Terminomics or degradomics
• Protease biochemistry
• Quantitative proteomics with isobaric or metabolic labelling
• Scripting for proteomics data analysis (R, Python), search engines, downstream statistics
• Experience in adapting or establishing proteomics workflows for new sample types or questions. Tell us about one in your cover letter.
• Work with plant material
• Supervision or teaching experience

Read the second list as a description of the project, not a test. In particular, prior N-terminomics experience is not required. Candidates who would do this job well routinely talk themselves out of applying because they match four points instead of seven. Tell us in your cover letter what you would need to learn.

We offer
• Modern Working Conditions: Comprehensive introduction to work techniques and a modern research environment with state-of-the-art equipment and up-to-date software
• Career Development: Targeted training opportunities and access to a specialized library with electronic resources and quiet workspaces
• Compensation & Security: Classification according to TV-L including annual bonus, pension scheme (VBL), health offers, and discounted canteen meals
• Ideal Working Environment: A varied and inspiring workplace in an international setting at a leading scientific and innovation hub
• Team Spirit and Leadership Culture: An open culture that strengthens teamwork, enables career networking, and promotes your research skills.
• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working models, remote work options, and 30 days of annual leave – for a balanced work-life experience.

About us The Independent Research Group Receptor Biochemistry, led by Dr. Mariana Schuster, is dedicated to understanding and engineering the molecular decisions that determine whether a plant gets sick, focusing on the proteases deployed by plants and pathogens and the proteins they cut. We are small, international and deliberately interdisciplinary. People here come from plant science, biochemistry, chemistry and computational backgrounds, and much of the useful thinking happens in the conversations between them. The IPB is a non-university research institute of the Leibniz Association on the Weinberg Campus of Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg, a foundation under public law under the direct supervision of the state of Saxony-Anhalt. Around 200 people work here, including about 40 doctoral researchers, across four scientific departments and two independent research groups. Research at the IPB aims to understand the (bio)chemical basis of plant resilience and performance in challenging environments related to climate change. The IPB offers excellent research facilities and state-of-the-art infrastructure, including in-house mass spectrometry. More at ipb-halle.de. Halle (Saale) is a green, walkable city with a large student population, low living costs by German standards, and fast connections to Leipzig and Berlin.

Dr. Mariana Schuster
Head of Research Group

- A degree level or equivalent within Information Technology

- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of Business Information Technology

- Strong verbal and written communication in our local language (German) and business language (English)

Online application -> Online Task Based Assessment -> Application Review (Talent Acquisition Partner & Manager) -> Virtual Assessment Centre -> Offer!

The Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, with its tradition spanning more than 600 years, is one of the largest research institutions in the Leipzig region. With over 1,300 employees, it is the largest of the university's 14 faculties and serves as a training center for approximately 3,500 students in human medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and midwifery.

We are seeking a highly motivated Epidemiologist to design and conduct epidemiological research in pediatric populations, focusing on the determinants of child health, the development of common childhood diseases, particularly obesity, and the prevention and long-term outcomes of childhood obesity and metabolic diseases.
The research group "Childhood Obesity and Metabolic Research", led by Antje Körner, investigates the development, mechanisms and health consequences of childhood obesity. We have large, well-characterized cohorts up and running with a longitudinal setting and across the entire age range: LIFE Child (n~6000), Leipzig Obesity Childhood Cohort (n~2500), and Leipzig Adipose Tissue Childhood cohort (n~700), with deep phenotyping allowing for combining clinical, epidemiological, lifestyle and functional omics and multi-omics data.

AnstellungsdetailsPermanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin
InfoWho we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

In Marketplace Management we work behind the scenes to make sure that new offers keep turning up on our online marketplaces. Each team focuses on one area. In the Partner Management & B2B Marketing team, we acquire and support our partner companies – such as software interface providers – and take care of optimizations and joint marketing activities. With the help of our interface partners, we enable our sellers to sell their products on our online marketplaces in a short time and have an optimal online presence.

AufgabenYour tasks – this is what awaits you in detail
• You build new partnerships with European e-commerce partners for the Kaufland Marketplaces and own the entire onboarding process
• You act as an enabler between partner offerings and seller success: you evaluate partner solutions based on the concrete problem they solve for our sellers (onboarding, logistics, pricing, content, repricing, etc.) and use and present them as growth enabler
• You ensure partner solutions aren't just onboarded but actively integrated and used in the seller journey - through documentations and first marketing activities on partner site
• You track adoption of partner solutions among sellers and derive optimizations from it - success is measured by seller impact (activation, GMV, churn reduction), not just partner satisfaction
• You gather seller feedback on partner solutions and translate it into concrete requirements for partners as well as product ideas for other teams
• You work closely with Sales, Product Management, Customer Service, Marketing, and Tech Development to turn ideas into real new features with high adoption rate
• You represent our marketplace at e-commerce events and grow your network of multipliers there

ProfilYour profile – this is what we expect from you
• You have successfully finished a business apprenticeship or own a university degree (e.g. Information Systems, Business Administration)
• You have 2-3 years of experience in partner management, business development, or product management within e-commerce
• You understand APIs and technical integration concepts well enough to translate between partners and engineering - deep technical/coding skills are not required, experience with Jira, Tableau, and BigQuery is a plus
• You think and act strategically, with a strong ability to prioritize and build a partner / product roadmap
• You have a proactive attitude and a hands-on mentality
• You enjoy working in an international environment and you are fluent in English (C1); good German skills (B2) or additional European language skills are a plus

BenefitsWhat we offer
• Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
• Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios : Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
• Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
• Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
• Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers : Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
• ‘ Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility
• Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
• Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it's up to you
• Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback
• This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
• We are team players : From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!

Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!
BewerbenDiversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. We are signatories to the Charta der Vielfalt (German Diversity Charter) – because we know that extraordinary things can only be achieved with diversity. Read more here! When applying, you can optionally include your pronouns in your resume.

Why are you the perfect fit for this position? Don't bother with cover letters - we're interested in facts and figures! Feel free to share your Github profile with us in your application.

We are looking forward to your application!

InfoWho we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

AufgabenYour tasks – this is what awaits you in detail
Building, developing and enabling high performing teams who build awesome products is the main responsibility for our Engineering Managers. It’s the entry position in our Engineering Management career path and reports to a Head of Product Engineering.

As an Engineering Manager joining our team, you will initially focus on hands-on technical tasks like an individual contributor allowing you to gain a deep understanding of our infrastructure and systems so that you know the code inside and out before adding managerial responsibilities to your plate. This approach enables you to understand the technical challenges your team encounters deeply, setting you and the team up for future wins.
• You have found your passion in software development, but you enjoy building the right team, removing roadblocks, helping others, creating transparency, and alignment even more than being an individual contributor
• Based on your experience, you will start by leading the engineers of one product team in a you-build-it-you-run-it environment, with a clear perspective to expand to multiple teams as responsibility and impact grow
• Depending on team size and setup, you will remain hands-on to a reasonable extent, especially where technical guidance, architectural decisions, code reviews, or complex problem-solving are needed
• You are going to help our engineers grow personally and professionally - not only by advancing their skills, but also by inspiring them through purpose
• You make sure that we leverage (new) technology within our product teams to build products customers love and work for the business
• You are accountable for delivery and reliability of your teams’ products, balancing scope, quality, performance, and operational stability in a high-traffic B2C environment
• You will contribute to strategic initiatives that are larger than your team(s) like raising the engineering bar, improving our guidelines, and defining how we work as an organization

ProfilYour profile – this is what we expect from you
• You have worked in cross-functional product teams and bring a vast experience in engineering of scalable web applications
• You are an experienced Engineering Manager who approaches technical challenges pragmatically, choosing tools and architectures that fit both the problem domain and the organization. This typically includes TypeScript, Vue.js, modern frontend tooling, and backend integrations with Node.js/PHP
• You possess an outstanding sense of ownership, passion and drive which brings energy to the room
• You communicate clearly and effectively, know how to create alignment, and understand what matters, especially in a remote and distributed setup
• You already have some experience in a management role and building successful teams and you are motivated to grow even more in the role of a successful Engineering Manager
• You are a natural go-to-person within your organization by mentoring other engineers and helping them grow and succeed
• You are willing to go the extra mile to make your team successful, you give honest feedback, and you are able to discuss, commit and execute
• You are fluent in English (C1) and enjoy working in an international environment

BenefitsWhat we offer
• Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
• Do you want to move to Germany? No problem – we offer you an attractive relocation package to give you a smooth start.
• Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
• Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
• Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
• Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers: Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
• ‘Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility
• Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
• Free choice of operating system: MacOS or Ubuntu Linux, it's up to you
• Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback. We cover the costs for relevant conferences, training opportunities, and approved team workshops to strengthen personal interactions
• This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
• We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!
